quotes.text: AI is not a toy. AI is not a fad. It is, in my view, a leap on the scale of the personal computer, of the smart phone, of the Internet, even of the printing press. We cannot afford to ignore it. And speaking as a Democrat, we cannot let our legitimate environmental concerns blind us to the strategic imperative of AI development.

That is why I introduced H.R. 3679. This bipartisan legislation directs the National Institute of Standards and Technology to develop resources to voluntarily educate small businesses on best practices when integrating AI into their businesses.
